prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full-bleed desktop web game cover background, landscape 3:2
Primary request: Create an original cinematic 3D animated family-adventure underwater scene for a children's game called Blue Ocean Base Rebuild. The emotional polish and lighting should evoke a premium theatrical family animation, with rounded expressive forms, rich character appeal, and storytelling depth.
Scene/backdrop: a damaged yet magical underwater research base after a storm, coral apartment domes on one side, a broken glowing current-power conduit weaving across the seabed, and a welcoming ocean council hall in the distance. Schools of tiny fish, bubbles, soft coral, and volumetric sun rays create depth.
Subject: a friendly original pink mechanical dolphin AI guide named Momo, wearing luminous blue technology headphones, swimming toward the viewer with an inviting, brave expression. Small original sea-creature friends follow behind, ready to rebuild.
Composition/framing: wide cinematic hero composition. Keep the left 38 percent darker, calmer, and relatively uncluttered for Chinese title and CTA overlay. Place Momo prominently around the center-right. The three damaged mission locations should read clearly in depth without looking like UI cards.
Lighting/mood: hopeful after-the-storm dawn underwater, turquoise and deep navy environment, warm coral-orange and golden repair lights, luminous caustics, emotional cinematic rim light.
Materials/textures: polished stylized 3D, tactile coral, soft translucent fins, rounded architecture, detailed but child-friendly.
Constraints: entirely original characters and world; no existing copyrighted characters; no logos; no lettering; no UI; no border; no watermark; no scary imagery; no photorealism. Leave usable negative space on left for interface copy.
